title: Activity & fitness
description: How much you move and train, every source side by side: steps, strain and calories burned per day, intensity minutes and VO2 max, workouts per week (time, count, calories) and heart-rate zones.

list.name: tz
list.label: Time zone
list.description: IANA time zone the days and weeks are cut in (TRIBUTARY_TZ).

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.description: The person, in BodyStats (GarminStats holds one person and has no user tag).
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "exercise" WITH KEY = "user"
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "exercise" WITH KEY = "user"

list.name: days
list.label: Daily activity sources
list.description: Every source of daily totals (steps, strain) in BodyStats.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "daily_activity" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "daily_activity" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: workouts
list.label: Workout sources
list.description: The sources of workouts in BodyStats that write no daily total.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "exercise" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "exercise" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: source
list.label: Sources
list.description: The sources the graphs draw, one colour each.

list.name: from
list.label: Tiles from
list.description: The one source the tiles and the heart-rate zones read.

panels.title: Steps / day
panels.description: Median steps per day, from the source picked in Tiles from (a source of workouts alone has none).

targets.query: SELECT median("totalSteps") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE 'garmin' = '${from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT median("steps") FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "source" = '${from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Intensity / week
panels.description: Moderate minutes plus twice the vigorous ones, per week, averaged over the days the watch recorded. The guideline is 150 or more.

targets.query: SELECT (sum("moderateIntensityMinutes") + 2 * sum("vigorousIntensityMinutes")) * 7 / count("totalSteps") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: VO₂ max
panels.description: The watch's latest VO₂ max estimate (ml/kg/min, running).

targets.query: SELECT last("VO2_max_value") FROM "VO2_Max" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Workouts
panels.description: Workouts in the range, from the source picked in Tiles from (a workout two apps received is in both).

targets.query: SELECT count("elapsedDuration") FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT count("duration_s") FROM "exercise" WHERE "source" = '${from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "category" != 'adjustment' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Training / week
panels.description: Hours of workouts per week over the range, from the source picked in Tiles from.

targets.query: SELECT sum("elapsedDuration") / 3600 / ((${__to} - ${__from}) / 604800000) FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 / ((${__to} - ${__from}) / 604800000) FROM "exercise" WHERE "source" = '${from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "category" != 'adjustment' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Workout days
panels.description: Days with at least one workout, from the source picked in Tiles from.

targets.query: SELECT count("n") FROM (SELECT count("elapsedDuration") AS "n" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${from}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')) WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT count("n") FROM (SELECT count("duration_s") AS "n" FROM "exercise" WHERE "source" = '${from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "category" != 'adjustment' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Steps per day
panels.description: Steps each day (points) and their 7-day average (line), one colour per source.

targets.query: SELECT sum("totalSteps") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(sum("totalSteps"), 7) FROM "DailyStats" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT "steps" FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"
SELECT moving_average("steps", 7) FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Strain per day
panels.description: The day's cardiovascular strain (0-21) from the sources that write it, each day (points) and its 7-day average (line). garmin-grafana has no strain.

targets.query: SELECT "strain" FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"
SELECT moving_average("strain", 7) FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Calories burned per day
panels.description: Energy spent each day, at rest and moving, as each source estimates it (the watch: resting plus active calories).

targets.query: SELECT sum("activeKilocalories") + sum("bmrKilocalories") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(sum("activeKilocalories"), 7) + moving_average(sum("bmrKilocalories"), 7) FROM "DailyStats" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT "energy_kcal" FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"
SELECT moving_average("energy_kcal", 7) FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Intensity minutes per week
panels.description: Moderate minutes plus twice the vigorous ones, per week (Monday to Sunday); the dashed line is the 150-minute guideline.

targets.query: SELECT sum("moderateIntensityMinutes") + 2 * sum("vigorousIntensityMinutes") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, 4d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.title: VO₂ max
panels.description: The watch's VO₂ max estimates (ml/kg/min), running and cycling (dashed).

targets.query: SELECT last("VO2_max_value") FROM "VO2_Max" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none)
SELECT last("VO2_max_value_cycling") FROM "VO2_Max" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none)

panels.title: Workout time per week
panels.description: Hours of workouts per week (Monday to Sunday), one line per source: a workout that two apps received is in both lines.

targets.query: SELECT sum("elapsedDuration") / 3600 FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, 4d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 FROM "exercise" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "category" != 'adjustment' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, 4d), "source" fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Workouts per week
panels.description: Workouts per week, one line per source.

targets.query: SELECT count("elapsedDuration") FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, 4d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
SELECT count("duration_s") FROM "exercise" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "category" != 'adjustment' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, 4d), "source" fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Workout calories per week
panels.description: Calories the workouts burned, per week, as each source estimates them.

targets.query: SELECT sum("calories") FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, 4d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "category" != 'adjustment' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, 4d), "source" fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Time in heart-rate zones per week · ${from}
panels.description: Hours of workouts spent in each heart-rate zone, per week, from the source picked in Tiles from (each device draws its own zone boundaries; a diary has none): zone 2 is the easy aerobic base, zones 4 and 5 the hard efforts.

targets.query: SELECT sum("hrTimeInZone_1") / 3600 AS "Zone 1", sum("hrTimeInZone_2") / 3600 AS "Zone 2", sum("hrTimeInZone_3") / 3600 AS "Zone 3", sum("hrTimeInZone_4") / 3600 AS "Zone 4", sum("hrTimeInZone_5") / 3600 AS "Zone 5" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${from}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, 4d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("zone1_s") / 3600 AS "Zone 1", sum("zone2_s") / 3600 AS "Zone 2", sum("zone3_s") / 3600 AS "Zone 3", sum("zone4_s") / 3600 AS "Zone 4", sum("zone5_s") / 3600 AS "Zone 5" FROM "exercise" WHERE "source" = '${from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "category" != 'adjustment' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, 4d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
